name: Recursive Dependency Admission Gate Registry
purpose: Create a formal admission gate that determines whether any recursive dependency may enter theorem-facing, simulation-facing, or review-facing infrastructure after passing the Recursive Inheritance Firewall.

admission_targets.name: Theorem-Facing Admission
admission_targets.requirement: Only INHERITANCE-ALLOWED or explicitly constrained INHERITANCE-CONDITIONAL artifacts may enter theorem-facing review.

admission_targets.name: Simulation-Facing Admission
admission_targets.requirement: Simulation inputs must exclude quarantined, blocked, deceptive, or unresolved global-composition artifacts unless explicitly used as stress-test cases.

admission_targets.name: Review-Facing Admission
admission_targets.requirement: Review artifacts must preserve all open blockers, excluded domains, and simulation-evidence limits.

admission_targets.name: Quarantine Enforcement
admission_targets.requirement: INHERITANCE-BLOCKED and INHERITANCE-QUARANTINED artifacts must not enter proof-supporting chains.

admission_targets.name: LAW034 Composition Guard
admission_targets.requirement: No admitted dependency may imply global compositional closure.

admission_classes.meaning: Dependency may enter restricted-local review infrastructure.
Dependency may enter only with explicit constraints, blockers, and review-required status.
Dependency may be used only as adversarial simulation or failure-testing input.
Dependency may not enter theorem-facing, review-facing, or proof-supporting infrastructure.
Dependency retained only for historical, diagnostic, or failure-geometry reference.
